qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: MSc or any equivalent postgraduate qualification in Life Sciences / Immunology/ Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Molecular Biology etc. Candidates should have either of the following as per ANRF norms: 1. Being selected through National Eligibility Tests- CSIR-UGC-NET including lectureship and GATE. 2. Similar fellowships exams conducted by DBT or ICMR or other similar agencies. Desirable: Candidates should have cleared their independent fellowship exam at AIIMS Bilaspur for enrolment in the PhD program. Preference in selection will be given to such candidates.

selection_process: Candidates will be screened for eligibility based on essential and desirable qualifications and shortlisted candidates will be called for an offline interview to be held at the department. Exact details to be communicated via email.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at AIIMS Bilaspur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at AIIMS Bilaspur is August 19, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc or an equivalent postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Immunology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a related field.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit is 28 years for the General Category. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA, as per institutional/ECRG norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their CV and required documents as a single PDF file via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates will be screened based on their qualifications. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an offline interview at the department.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any specific eligibility criteria related to national-level tests?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have been selected through national eligibility tests like CSIR-UGC-NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or similar fellowship exams conducted by DBT or ICMR.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any preference given to certain candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates who have cleared their independent fellowship exam at AIIMS Bilaspur for enrollment in the PhD program.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, specifically for research purposes at AIIMS Bilaspur.

faq.question: Q10. Where is AIIMS Bilaspur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bilaspur is located in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh.
